description: List or activate a toolset for this session. Omit category to list; pass one to enable. Prefer this over GITLAB_TOOLSETS=all (loads ~all schemas). Session-only; with OAUTH_STATELESS_MODE=true persist `GITLAB_TOOLSETS=core,<category>` instead. Categories: core, merge_requests, issues, repositories, branches, projects, labels, ci, groups, pipelines, milestones, wiki, releases, tags, snippets, users, workitems, webhooks, search, variables, dependency_proxy, vulnerabilities, orbit. Response lists already-active ones. api is explicit-only.

category.description: Toolset to activate (e.g. pipelines, wiki). Omit to list. Prefer a category over GITLAB_TOOLSETS=all. Session-only; persist `GITLAB_TOOLSETS=core,<category>` when OAUTH_STATELESS_MODE=true.

jmespath.description: Optional JMESPath expression filtering the JSON result before return.

name: discover_tools
